months.label: 0-kun
tasks: Lotin alifbosidagi barcha 26 harfni tartib bilan o'qish va yozishni mashq qilish
Har bir harf uchun kamida bitta misol so'zni yod olish
Unli va undosh harflarni farqlashni o'rganish

grammar.title: Ingliz alifbosi — 26 harf
grammar.text: Ingliz alifbosida 26 harf bor: 5 tasi unli (a, e, i, o, u) va 21 tasi undosh. "Y" harfi holatga qarab ham unli, ham undosh vazifasini bajarishi mumkin (masalan "yellow"da undosh, "gym"da unli). Ingliz tilida harf nomi va uning so'z ichidagi talaffuzi ko'pincha farq qiladi — masalan "C" harfi nomi "si" deb o'qiladi, lekin "cat" so'zida "k" tovushini beradi, "city" so'zida esa "s" tovushini beradi. Shuning uchun har bir so'zni alohida talaffuz bilan yodlash muhim.
examples: mushuk (k tovushi) — shahar (s tovushi), ikkalasi ham "c" bilan boshlanadi
malika — "q" harfidan keyin deyarli har doim "u" keladi
rentgen — "x" harfi so'z boshida kam uchraydi

more.title: Harflarni talaffuz qilish bo'yicha maslahat
more.text: Ingliz alifbosida 26 harf bor, lekin tovushlar 44 ga yaqin. Shuning uchun harf nomi va tovushini alohida o'rganing: masalan, 'a' harfi 'cat' so'zida [æ], 'name' so'zida [eɪ] deb o'qiladi. Ismni harflab aytish (spelling) tanishuvda juda kerak.

more.title: Katta va kichik harflar
more.text: Ingliz tilida gap boshi, shaxs ismlari, mamlakat va tillar nomi, hafta kunlari va oylar bosh harf bilan yoziladi. 'I' (men) olmoshi doim katta harf bilan yoziladi.

dialog.title: Let's read the alphabet together
lines: Let's read the alphabet in order.
Okay! A, B, C, D, E, F, G...
Yaxshi! Ey, Bi, Si, Di, I, Ef, Ji...
Great! Now let's try a word for each letter.
Ajoyib! Endi har bir harf uchun so'z sinab ko'ramiz.

exercises: Barcha 26 harfni katta va kichik shaklda daftaringizga yozib chiqing
Har bir harf uchun yuqoridagidan boshqa yana bitta yangi so'z toping
Alifboni ovoz chiqarib, boshidan oxirigacha 2 marta o'qing
Ixtiyoriy 5 ta harfni tanlab, ular bilan boshlanadigan 2 tadan so'z yozing
"C" harfi turlicha talaffuz qilingan 2 ta so'zni toping (masalan cat va city)
answers: Erkin javob — turli xil to'g'ri so'zlar bo'lishi mumkin.
months.teacher: Bu dars — butun kursning poydevori, shuning uchun shoshilmang. Har bir harfni ismi (letter name) va so'z ichidagi mumkin bo'lgan talaffuzlari bilan birga namoyish eting. "C" va "G" kabi ikki xil talaffuzga ega harflarga, shuningdek "th", "sh", "ch" kabi harf birikmalariga alohida e'tibor bering — bular keyingi darslarda talaffuz asosini tashkil qiladi. Darsni alifboni battaraf yakuniga yetkazmasdan keyingi darsga o'tmang.

dialog2.title: Meeting a new classmate
lines: Hello! My name is Ali. What is your name?
Salom! Mening ismim Ali. Sizning ismingiz nima?
Hi, Ali. I am Dilya. Nice to meet you.
Salom, Ali. Men Dilyaman. Tanishganimdan xursandman.
How do you spell your name?
Thank you. Are you a new student?
Yes, I am. This is my first day.
Welcome! Let me show you the classroom.

reading.title: My first English lesson
reading.text: Today is my first English lesson. The teacher is kind. She writes the alphabet on the board. We read the letters together: A, B, C, D. Then we spell our names. I am a little shy, but I am happy.
reading.uz: Bugun mening birinchi ingliz tili darsim. O'qituvchi mehribon. U doskaga alifboni yozadi. Biz harflarni birga o'qiymiz: A, B, C, D. Keyin ismlarimizni harflaymiz. Men biroz uyatchanman, lekin xursandman.
questions: It is my first English lesson.
What does the teacher write on the board?
He/She is a little shy, but happy.

months.label: 1-oy
tasks: Ingliz alifbosi va tovushlarni mashq qilish

grammar.title: Ingliz alifbosi va talaffuz
grammar.text: Ingliz tilida 26 harf bor, lekin tovushlar soni ulardan ko'p — bir harf turli so'zlarda turlicha o'qiladi. Masalan, 'a' harfi cat, name, car so'zlarida uch xil talaffuz qilinadi. Shuning uchun har bir yangi so'zni transkripsiyasi bilan birga yodlash tavsiya etiladi.

more.title: To be fe'li: am / is / are
more.text: 'To be' fe'li shaxsga qarab o'zgaradi: I am, he/she/it is, you/we/they are. Qisqa shakllar og'zaki nutqda ko'p ishlatiladi: I'm, he's, they're.
examples: I am a student. = I'm a student.

more.title: Tanishuv so'roqlari
more.text: What is your name? (Ismingiz nima?), Where are you from? (Qayerdansiz?), How old are you? (Necha yoshdasiz?) — bular tanishuvning asosiy uchta savoli. Javobda to'liq gap ishlating.
examples: Where are you from? — I am from Tashkent.
How old are you? — I am twenty.

dialog.title: Tanishuv
lines: Hello! My name is Anvar. What's your name?
Salom! Mening ismim Anvar. Sizning ismingiz nima?
Nice to meet you! How are you?
Thank you, I'm fine. And you?

exercises: 'Th' tovushini (think, this) ovoz chiqarib mashq qiling va farqini tushuntiring.
Dialogni juftlikda o'qing, keyin o'z ismingiz bilan almashtirib qayta o'ynang.
Tarjima qiling: «Rahmat, yaxshiman. Sizchi?»
months.teacher: Darsni juftlik mashqi bilan boshlang: har bir talaba sinfdoshi bilan yangi so'zlar yordamida tanishsin. Talaffuzni, ayniqsa 'th' va unli tovushlarni, alohida nazorat qiling.

dialog2.title: At the language centre
lines: Good morning. How can I help you?
Xayrli tong. Sizga qanday yordam bera olaman?
I would like to join an English course.
Sure. What is your full name?
My name is Sara Karimova. S-A-R-A.
And what is your phone number?
Thank you. The course starts on Monday.

reading.title: Meet Sara
reading.text: Sara is twenty years old. She is from Samarkand. She is a student at the university. Now she is at a language centre because she wants to speak English well. Her phone number is 90 123 45 67.
reading.uz: Sara yigirma yoshda. U Samarqanddan. U universitetda talaba. Hozir u til markazida, chunki u inglizchani yaxshi gapirishni xohlaydi. Uning telefon raqami 90 123 45 67.
questions: Why is she at the language centre?
Because she wants to speak English well.

months.label: 2-oy
tasks: Hozirgi zamon (Present Simple) fe'llarini mashq qilish
Oila, ovqat va xarid mavzusidagi so'zlarni yodlash

grammar.title: Present Simple zamoni
grammar.text: Hozirgi zamon doimiy harakat yoki odatlarni bildiradi. He/she/it shaxsida fe'lga -s/-es qo'shiladi. Boshqa shaxslarda fe'l o'zgarmaydi.

more.title: Present Simple: -s qo'shimchasi
more.text: He/she/it bilan fe'lga -s (yoki -es) qo'shiladi: she works, he watches. Inkorda do not / does not ishlatiladi va fe'l asl holida qoladi: she does not work.

more.title: Savol tuzish: Do / Does
more.text: Savolda gap boshiga Do (I, you, we, they) yoki Does (he, she, it) qo'yiladi. Does dan keyin fe'lga -s qo'shilmaydi.
examples: U bu yerdan non sotib oladimi?

dialog.title: Do'konda
lines: Hello! How much is the bread?
Thanks, I'll take the bread and water.
Rahmat, men non va suv olaman.

exercises: 'Have' fe'lini barcha shaxslarda tuslang.
5 ta oila a'zosi nomini jumla ichida ishlating.
Do'kon dialogini davom ettirib, yana 3 ta gap qo'shing.
answers: I have, you have, he/she/it has, we have, they have.
months.teacher: Rolli o'yin tashkil qiling: «do'konda xarid qilish». Yarim guruh sotuvchi, yarmi xaridor bo'lsin, so'ng rollarni almashtiring.

dialog2.title: Shopping for fruit
lines: Good afternoon! What do you need?
I need some apples and bananas.
Menga bir oz olma va banan kerak.
How many apples do you want?
Two kilos, please. How much are they?
Ikki kilo, iltimos. Ular qancha turadi?
They are ten thousand soums per kilo.
OK. I buy two kilos of apples.
No, thank you. That is all.

reading.title: A day at the market
reading.text: Every Saturday my mother goes to the market. She buys vegetables, fruit and bread. The seller knows her and always says hello. My mother likes fresh apples, but she does not like expensive things. I often help her carry the bags.
reading.uz: Har shanba kuni onam bozorga boradi. U sabzavot, meva va non sotib oladi. Sotuvchi uni taniydi va doim salom beradi. Onam yangi olmani yaxshi ko'radi, lekin qimmat narsalarni yoqtirmaydi. Men ko'pincha unga sumkalarni ko'tarishda yordam beraman.
questions: When does the mother go to the market?
Who helps her carry the bags?

months.label: 3-oy

grammar.title: Artikllar va ko'plik son
grammar.text: 'A/an' aniqmas artikl — birinchi marta tilga olinayotgan yoki noaniq narsa uchun ishlatiladi ('an' unli tovushdan oldin). 'The' aniq artikl — allaqachon ma'lum narsa uchun. Ko'pchilik otlar ko'plikda -s qo'shimchasini oladi, lekin ba'zilari maxsus shaklga ega (child → children).
examples: I see the table (that we talked about).

more.title: a yoki an?
more.text: Undosh tovush bilan boshlanuvchi so'z oldidan 'a', unli tovush bilan boshlansa 'an' ishlatiladi. Muhimi yozuv emas, tovush: 'an hour' (h o'qilmaydi), 'a university' (y tovushi).

more.title: Ko'plikning qoidasiz shakllari
more.text: Ba'zi otlar -s olmaydi: man → men, woman → women, child → children, foot → feet, tooth → teeth, person → people. Ularni yodlab oling.

dialog.title: Kitob do'konida
lines: Men musiqa va kitoblarni yaxshi ko'raman.

exercises: Qavsdagi so'zga to'g'ri artikl qo'ying: I see (table/book).
3 ta gap tuzing, ularda ko'plik otlar ishlatilsin.
«Men mashinani ko'raman» gapini ingliz tiliga tarjima qiling.
answers: I see a table. I see a book.
months.teacher: Doskaga a/an/the ishlatilishi bo'yicha jadval chizing va har biriga misol yozdiring — bu farqni vizual eslab qolishga yordam beradi.

dialog2.title: Buying stationery
lines: Excuse me, do you have a notebook?
Yes, we have notebooks and pens.
Ha, bizda daftar va ruchkalar bor.
I need a pen and an eraser.
Here is a blue pen and an eraser.
The notebooks are on the shelf.
Thank you. I take an orange pen too.
Rahmat. Apelsin rangli ruchka ham olaman.

reading.title: The new classroom
reading.text: Our classroom is new. There are twenty chairs, ten tables and a big board. There is an old clock on the wall. Every student has a notebook and a pen. The teacher has an orange bag and a lot of books.
reading.uz: Bizning sinfimiz yangi. Yigirmata stul, o'nta stol va katta doska bor. Devorda eski soat bor. Har bir o'quvchida daftar va ruchka bor. O'qituvchining apelsin rangli sumkasi va ko'p kitoblari bor.
questions: An orange bag and a lot of books.

months.label: 4-oy

grammar.title: Egalik sifatlari: my/his/her/our
grammar.text: Ingliz tilida egalik sifatlari (possessive adjectives) egaga qarab tanlanadi, tavsiflanayotgan otning jinsi/soniga bog'liq emas: my father, her mother, our house.

more.title: There is / There are
more.text: Biror narsaning borligini aytish uchun: there is (birlik), there are (ko'plik). Inkori: there is not (isn't), there are not (aren't). Savol: Is there...? Are there...?
examples: There is a sofa in the room.

more.title: Egalik: 's
more.text: Ega ismiga 's qo'shilsa 'kimning' ma'nosi chiqadi: my brother's room (akamning xonasi). Ko'plikda s dan keyin faqat apostrof: my parents' house.

dialog.title: My Family
lines: My family isn't very big: my mother, my father and my brother.
Mening oilam unchalik katta emas: onam, otam va akam.
We live in an apartment. We have three rooms and a kitchen.
Biz kvartirada yashaymiz. Bizda uchta xona va oshxona bor.

exercises: 5 ta oila a'zosi nomini yozing.
Egalik sifatlari bilan 3 ta gap tuzing.
O'z uyingizni 3-4 gapda tasvirlab bering.
months.teacher: Talabalarga o'z oilasi fotosuratini (yoki chizmasini) tasvirlashni so'rang — bu egalik sifatlarini tabiiy tarzda mashq qildiradi.

dialog2.title: Talking about a house
lines: I live in a big house with my family.
Men oilam bilan katta uyda yashayman.
There are five rooms and a garden.
No, it is small, but it is comfortable.
My parents, my brother and my grandmother.

reading.title: My grandmother
reading.text: My grandmother lives with us. She is seventy years old. She wakes up early and makes tea for everybody. In the evening she tells stories to the children. Her room is next to the kitchen. We love her very much.
reading.uz: Buvim biz bilan yashaydi. U yetmish yoshda. U erta turadi va hamma uchun choy damlaydi. Kechqurun u bolalarga ertak aytib beradi. Uning xonasi oshxonaning yonida. Biz uni juda yaxshi ko'ramiz.
questions: What does she do in the evening?
She tells stories to the children.

months.label: 5-oy

grammar.title: Sifatlar tartibi (rang oldidan o'lcham)
grammar.text: Ingliz tilida bir necha sifat ketma-ket kelganda, ma'lum tartib bo'ladi: o'lcham odatda rangdan oldin keladi — a big red house (katta qizil uy), not «a red big house».

more.title: Sifat otdan oldin keladi
more.text: Ingliz tilida sifat otdan oldin turadi va o'zgarmaydi: a red car, red cars. Sifat ko'plikka qo'shimcha olmaydi.

more.title: Ranglarni tasvirlash
more.text: Rangni ochiq/to'q qilish uchun light va dark so'zlari rang oldiga qo'yiladi: light blue, dark green. Shakl: round (yumaloq), square (kvadrat), long (uzun).

dialog.title: Choosing Clothes at a Shop
lines: Hello! Do you have a blue shirt?
Medium, please. Do you also have it in red?
O'rtacha, iltimos. Yana qizil rangi bormi?

exercises: 6 ta rang nomini yozing.
Sifatlar tartibi bilan 3 ta gap tuzing.
O'z xonangizdagi 3 ta narsaning rangini tasvirlang.
months.teacher: Sinfda turli rangdagi buyumlarni ko'rsatib, talabalardan ularni ingliz tilida aytishni so'rang.

dialog2.title: Which colour do you like?
lines: What colour is your new bag?
It is dark green. I love green.
To'q yashil. Men yashilni yaxshi ko'raman.
Is it a big bag or a small one?
It is a medium round bag.
My favourite colour is blue, like the sky.
Blue is nice. Do you like red too?
Not really. Red is too bright for me.
Unchalik emas. Qizil men uchun juda yorqin.
I understand. Everybody has a different taste.
Tushunaman. Har kimning didi har xil.

reading.title: Colours around us
reading.text: The sky is blue and the grass is green. The sun is yellow and the snow is white. In my room the walls are light yellow, and the carpet is brown. I like bright colours because they make me happy.
reading.uz: Osmon ko'k, maysa yashil. Quyosh sariq, qor oq. Mening xonamda devorlar och sariq, gilam esa jigarrang. Men yorqin ranglarni yoqtiraman, chunki ular meni xursand qiladi.
questions: What colour are the walls in the room?
Why does the writer like bright colours?

months.label: 6-oy
tasks: «would like» bilan xushmuomalalik bilan buyurtma berish

grammar.title: «Would like» bilan xushmuomalalik bilan so'rash
grammar.text: Restoranda buyurtma berishda «I would like…» (I'd like) «want» dan ko'ra xushmuomalaroq hisoblanadi: I'd like to order some soup.
examples: I'd like to order some soup.
Could I have some water, please?
Could we have the bill, please?

more.title: Would like va Can/Could
more.text: 'I would like...' — 'Men ... xohlardim' degan xushmuomala shakl. 'Could I have...?' va 'Can I have...?' — iltimos qilish. Could — yanada xushmuomala.
examples: I would like a cup of tea.
Could I have the menu, please?

more.title: Sanaladigan va sanalmaydigan otlar
more.text: Sanaladigan: apple, egg (a/an, -s). Sanalmaydigan: water, rice, bread (ko'plik yo'q). Ular bilan some/much, sanaladiganlar bilan many ishlatiladi.
examples: How much rice? How many eggs?

dialog.title: Ordering at a Restaurant
lines: Hello! What would you like to order?
One soup and a salad, please.
And what would you like to drink?
Tea, please. And could we have the bill when it's ready?
Choy, iltimos. Va tayyor bo'lganda hisob-kitobni olib keling.

exercises: 5 ta taom/ichimlik nomini yozing.
«I'd like…» bilan 3 ta gap tuzing.
Restoranda buyurtma berish dialogini yozing.
months.teacher: Rolli o'yin: bir talaba ofitsiant, ikkinchisi mijoz bo'lib real menyu asosida buyurtma berish mashqini o'ynasin.

dialog2.title: Booking a table
lines: Hello, I would like to book a table for four.
Salom, to'rt kishilik stol band qilmoqchiman.
Could I have your name, please?
Would you like a table by the window?

reading.title: Dinner at a restaurant
reading.text: On Friday we went to a nice restaurant. The waiter brought the menu. I ordered soup and grilled chicken, and my sister ordered a salad. For dessert we had ice cream. The food was delicious and the service was very polite.
reading.uz: Juma kuni biz chiroyli restoranga bordik. Ofitsiant menyuni olib keldi. Men sho'rva va grilda tovuq buyurtma qildim, singlim esa salat buyurtma qildi. Desertga muzqaymoq yedik. Ovqat mazali va xizmat juda xushmuomala edi.

months.label: 7-oy

grammar.title: Vaqtni so'rash: What time is it? / What time...?
grammar.text: «What time is it?» — hozir soat necha ekanligini so'rash uchun, «What time do you...?» esa biror harakat qachon sodir bo'lishini so'rash uchun ishlatiladi.
examples: What time is it? — It's seven o'clock.
What time do you get up?

more.title: Chastota ravishlari
more.text: always (doim), usually (odatda), often (tez-tez), sometimes (ba'zan), never (hech qachon). Ular odatda asosiy fe'ldan oldin, 'to be' dan keyin keladi.
examples: I usually drink tea in the morning.

more.title: Vaqt predloglari
more.text: at + soat (at 7:00), on + kun (on Monday), in + kun qismi (in the morning), lekin at night. 'half past six' = 6:30, 'quarter to seven' = 6:45.

dialog.title: Talking About Daily Routine
lines: What time do you usually get up?
I get up early, at seven in the morning. And you?
Men erta, ertalab soat yettida turaman. Sen-chi?
I sometimes get up late, at nine.
I walk to work every day.
Men har kuni ishga piyoda boraman.

exercises: Kun tartibingizni soat bilan yozing (5 ta harakat).
Chastota ravishlari bilan 3 ta gap tuzing.
«What time...?» savoliga javob yozing.
months.teacher: Soat maketi yoki rasmidan foydalanib, talabalarga turli vaqtlarni navbat bilan aytishni so'rang.

dialog2.title: What is your daily routine?
lines: What time do you get up?
I get up at six thirty.
What do you do after breakfast?
I go to work at eight o'clock.
At one o'clock, usually with my colleagues.
And when do you go to bed?
Around eleven. I am always tired in the evening.
Soat o'n bir atrofida. Kechqurun doim charchagan bo'laman.

reading.title: A busy day
reading.text: Karim has a busy day. He gets up at six, has breakfast and goes to the university at eight. His classes finish at three. Then he goes to the gym for an hour. In the evening he does his homework and reads a book. He goes to bed at eleven.
reading.uz: Karimning kuni band. U oltida turadi, nonushta qiladi va sakkizda universitetga ketadi. Darslari uchda tugaydi. Keyin bir soat sport zaliga boradi. Kechqurun uy vazifasini bajaradi va kitob o'qiydi. U o'n birda uxlaydi.
questions: What does he do after classes?
When does he go to bed?

months.label: 1-oy
tasks: Muntazam va nomuntazam fe'llar bilan tanishish

grammar.title: Past Simple va nomuntazam fe'llar
grammar.text: Muntazam fe'llarga o'tgan zamonda -ed qo'shiladi (work → worked). Nomuntazam fe'llar esa maxsus shaklga ega bo'lib, ularni alohida yodlash kerak (go → went, buy → bought).

more.title: Muntazam fe'llar: -ed
more.text: Muntazam fe'llarga -ed qo'shiladi: work → worked, play → played. -e bilan tugasa faqat -d: live → lived. Undosh+y: study → studied.

more.title: Inkor va savol: did
more.text: Past Simple da inkor va savolda did / did not ishlatiladi, asosiy fe'l asl holida qoladi: Did you go? I did not go. Bu qoidani 'went' kabi nomuntazam fe'llarga ham qo'llang.
examples: I did not see him yesterday.

dialog.title: Kecha nima qildingiz?
lines: Yesterday I bought a book and read it all evening.
Kecha men kitob sotib oldim va kechqurun bo'yi o'qidim.
I went to the shop and cooked dinner.
Men esa do'konga bordim va kechki ovqat tayyorladim.

exercises: 5 ta nomuntazam fe'lni o'tgan zamon shaklida yozing.
'Did' bilan 3 ta savol tuzing.
Kecha nima qilganingiz haqida 3 ta gap yozing.
months.teacher: Talabalarga kechagi kuni haqida kichik hikoya yozdiring (5-6 gap), so'ng ovoz chiqarib o'qitib, fe'l shakllarini birgalikda tuzating.

dialog2.title: A weekend in the mountains
lines: Did you go anywhere last weekend?
O'tgan dam olish kunlari biror joyga bordingizmi?
Yes, we went to the mountains.
We took a bus and then walked for three hours.
Avtobusga o'tirdik, keyin uch soat piyoda yurdik.
Of course. I took more than a hundred.
It was sunny, but a little cold.

reading.title: A trip to Chimgan
reading.text: Last summer my friends and I visited Chimgan. We left early in the morning and arrived at ten. We walked along a river and ate lunch on the grass. In the afternoon it rained a little, so we returned to the bus. It was a tiring but wonderful day.
reading.uz: O'tgan yozda do'stlarim va men Chimyonga bordik. Ertalab erta chiqib, soat o'nda yetib keldik. Daryo bo'ylab yurdik va maysada tushlik qildik. Tushdan keyin ozgina yomg'ir yog'di, shuning uchun avtobusga qaytdik. Bu charchatadigan, lekin ajoyib kun edi.
questions: What did they do at lunchtime?
They ate lunch on the grass.
Why did they return to the bus?

months.label: 2-oy
tasks: Kelasi zamonni (will / going to) mashq qilish

grammar.title: Kelasi zamon va sifatlarni qiyoslash
grammar.text: 'Will' rejasiz, spontan qarorlar yoki bashoratlar uchun ishlatiladi. 'Going to' oldindan rejalashtirilgan harakatlar uchun ishlatiladi. Qisqa sifatlar -er qo'shimchasini oladi (big→bigger), uzun sifatlar oldiga 'more' qo'yiladi (interesting→more interesting).
examples: I will read a book tomorrow.
I'm going to watch a film tonight.
This book is more interesting than that one.

more.title: will va going to
more.text: 'Going to' — oldindan qilingan reja yoki ko'rinib turgan belgi: I am going to study. 'Will' — o'sha payt qabul qilingan qaror, bashorat, va'da: I will help you.
examples: Look at the clouds! It is going to rain.
Men sizga bugun kechqurun qo'ng'iroq qilaman.

more.title: Qiyosiy va orttirma daraja
more.text: Qisqa sifat: tall → taller → the tallest. Uzun sifat: more/most beautiful. Qoidasiz: good → better → the best, bad → worse → the worst.
examples: This book is more interesting than that one.
He is the best player in the team.

dialog.title: Ertangi rejalar
lines: Tomorrow I'll study English and maybe watch a film.
Ertaga ingliz tilini o'rganaman va, ehtimol, film ko'raman.
Which film is better — a comedy or a drama?
Qaysi film yaxshiroq — komediya yoki drama?
I think a comedy is more interesting.

exercises: 3 ta gapni 'will' yordamida kelasi zamonga qo'ying.
'Good', 'bad', 'big' so'zlarining qiyosiy shaklini yozing.
Ertangi kuningiz rejasi haqida qisqa matn yozing (4-5 gap).
answers: Masalan: I will work. I will rest. I will cook.
months.teacher: Bu oyda birinchi jonli suhbat mashqini tashkil qiling — tandem hamkor yoki repetitor bilan 15 daqiqalik erkin suhbat, oldindan 5 ta savol tayyorlab boring.

dialog2.title: Plans for next year
lines: What are you going to do next year?
I am going to study English in London.
I think it will be more expensive than here.
Maybe. I will look for a part-time job.
I am sure you will do well.
Thank you, that is very kind.

reading.title: My plan for the future
reading.text: In five years I want to be a doctor. First I will finish school, then I will enter the medical university. It will be difficult, but I am going to work hard. My father says that a good doctor is the happiest person in the world.
reading.uz: Besh yildan keyin men shifokor bo'lishni xohlayman. Avval maktabni tugataman, keyin tibbiyot universitetiga kiraman. Bu qiyin bo'ladi, lekin men qattiq mehnat qilmoqchiman. Dadam yaxshi shifokor dunyodagi eng baxtli odam, deydi.
questions: What does the writer want to be?
A good doctor is the happiest person in the world.

months.label: 3-oy
tasks: Kundalik mavzularda erkin gapirishni mashq qilish
1 ta qisqa video/epizodni subtitr bilan ko'rish

grammar.title: In / On / At — umumlashtirish jadvali
grammar.text: Ingliz tilida uchta asosiy predlog joy va vaqtni bildiradi: 'in' katta joy/oy/yil uchun, 'on' kun va sirt uchun, 'at' aniq vaqt yoki nuqta uchun. Bu oyning maqsadi — ularni bitta tizim sifatida ko'rish va amaliyotda erkin qo'llash.

more.title: Joy predloglari
more.text: in front of (oldida), behind (orqasida), next to / beside (yonida), between (o'rtasida), opposite (qarshisida), under (ostida), above (tepasida).
examples: The cat is under the table.
The school is opposite the library.

more.title: Harakat predloglari
more.text: to (...ga), from (...dan), into (ichiga), out of (ichidan), across (kesib), through (orqali), along (bo'ylab).

dialog.title: Kundalik hayotda predloglar
lines: I was at the university, and then I talked with a friend about a film.
Men universitetda edim, keyin do'stim bilan film haqida gaplashdim.
What film did you talk about?
We talked about a new series.

exercises: In/on/at predloglarini misollar bilan farqlang.
Har bir predlog uchun bittadan gap tuzing.
Subtitrli video ko'rgandan so'ng, unda uchragan 5 ta predlogni yozib oling.
months.teacher: In/on/at jadvalini katta qog'ozga chizib, sinf devoriga osib qo'yish tavsiya etiladi — bu bosqich ko'p talabalar uchun qiyin joy, shuning uchun vizual yordam muhim.

dialog2.title: Where is it?
lines: Excuse me, where is the post office?
It is between the bank and the pharmacy.
No, it is opposite the park.
Thank you. And the bus stop?
It is behind that building, next to the cafe.
U anavi bino orqasida, kafening yonida.

reading.title: My neighbourhood
reading.text: My neighbourhood is quiet and green. There is a small park in front of my house, and a bakery next to it. Behind the bakery there is a school. Every morning I walk through the park to the bus stop, which is opposite the pharmacy.
reading.uz: Mening mahallam sokin va ko'm-ko'k. Uyim oldida kichik park, uning yonida novvoyxona bor. Novvoyxona orqasida maktab bor. Har ertalab men park orqali dorixona qarshisidagi avtobus bekatiga yuraman.
questions: What is in front of the house?

months.label: 4-oy

grammar.title: «It is + sifat» ob-havo haqida
grammar.text: Ob-havoni tasvirlashda «it» — mavhum ega sifatida ishlatiladi: It is cold today (Bugun sovuq).

more.title: Ob-havo ifodalari
more.text: Ob-havoda 'it' rasmiy ega bo'lib ishlaydi: It is raining, It is cold, It snows in winter. 'What is the weather like?' — ob-havo qanday?

more.title: Present Continuous
more.text: Hozir davom etayotgan ish: am/is/are + fe'l-ing. Ob-havoda ham ishlatiladi: It is raining now.

dialog.title: Talking About the Weather
lines: Yes, it will be warm and sunny tomorrow.
Ha, ertaga issiq va quyoshli bo'ladi.

exercises: 4 fasl nomini va bittadan xususiyatini yozing.
«It is…» qolipida 3 ta ob-havo gapi tuzing.
O'zingiz yashaydigan joydagi bugungi ob-havoni tasvirlang.
months.teacher: Haqiqiy ob-havo prognozi saytidan foydalanib, talabalarga kunlik prognozni ingliz tilida o'qib berishni so'rang.

dialog2.title: Planning a picnic
lines: What is the weather like today?
Let us have a picnic then!
Good idea. But the forecast says it will rain tomorrow.
Yaxshi fikr. Lekin prognozda ertaga yomg'ir yog'adi deyilgan.
I will bring a blanket and some sandwiches.
Men ko'rpacha va sendvichlar olib kelaman.
I will take juice and fruit.
Perfect. Let us meet at noon.

reading.title: Four seasons
reading.text: In my country there are four seasons. Spring is green and fresh. Summer is very hot, and we eat a lot of watermelon. Autumn is rainy and golden. Winter is cold, and sometimes it snows. My favourite season is autumn because the weather is mild.
reading.uz: Mening mamlakatimda to'rt fasl bor. Bahor yam-yashil va salqin. Yoz juda issiq, biz ko'p tarvuz yeymiz. Kuz yomg'irli va oltin rangda. Qish sovuq, ba'zan qor yog'adi. Sevimli faslim kuz, chunki havo mo''tadil.
questions: What do people eat in summer?
Why does the writer like autumn?

months.label: 5-oy

grammar.title: Buyruq mayli (Imperative) yo'l ko'rsatishda
grammar.text: Yo'l ko'rsatishda fe'lning bosh shakli (infinitive without to) ishlatiladi: Go straight (to'g'riga yuring), Turn left (chapga buriling).
examples: The museum is nearby, around the corner.

more.title: Buyruq mayli inkori
more.text: Inkor buyruq: Do not (Don't) + fe'l. Taklif uchun: Let's + fe'l. Xushmuomalalik uchun please qo'shing.

more.title: Yo'nalish so'zlari
more.text: turn left/right (chapga/o'ngga buring), go straight on (to'g'riga yuring), at the corner (burchakda), at the traffic lights (svetoforda), take the second street (ikkinchi ko'chaga buriling).
examples: Take the second street on the right.

dialog.title: Asking for Directions
lines: Excuse me, where is the museum?
Go straight down this street, then turn right.
Shu ko'cha bo'ylab to'g'riga yuring, keyin o'ngga buriling.
No, it's near, about five minutes on foot.

exercises: 5 ta shahar obyekti nomini yozing.
Buyruq mayli bilan 3 ta yo'nalish gapi tuzing.
O'z uyingizdan maktabgacha yo'lni tasvirlang.
months.teacher: Sinfxona ichida yoki oddiy xaritadan foydalanib, talabalar juftlikda bir-biriga yo'l ko'rsatish mashqini o'tkazsin.

dialog2.title: Taking a taxi
lines: Turn left at the traffic lights, please.
Yes, go straight and stop at the corner.
Ha, to'g'riga yuring va burchakda to'xtang.
Here we are. That is fifteen thousand.
Here you are. Keep the change.

reading.title: Lost in the city
reading.text: Last week I was lost in a big city. I asked a policeman for help. He said: go straight on, turn right at the second street, and you will see the museum on your left. I thanked him and followed his directions. In ten minutes I was at my hotel.
reading.uz: O'tgan hafta men katta shaharda adashib qoldim. Politsiyachidan yordam so'radim. U dedi: to'g'riga yuring, ikkinchi ko'chadan o'ngga buriling, chap tomoningizda muzey ko'rinadi. Men unga rahmat aytdim va ko'rsatmasiga amal qildim. O'n daqiqada mehmonxonamda edim.
questions: Who did the writer ask for help?
Where did he say to turn?
How long did it take to reach the hotel?

months.label: 6-oy
tasks: Sport turlari va hobbi nomlarini bilish

grammar.title: «Like + gerund (-ing)»
grammar.text: Yoqtirilgan mashg'ulotni ifodalashda «like» dan keyin fe'lga -ing qo'shiladi: I like swimming (Men suzishni yaxshi ko'raman).

more.title: Like / love / hate + -ing
more.text: Yoqtirish va yoqtirmaslikni bildiruvchi fe'llardan keyin fe'l -ing shaklida keladi: like reading, love swimming, hate waking up early.

more.title: How often? — takrorlanish
more.text: once a week (haftada bir marta), twice a month (oyda ikki marta), three times a year (yilda uch marta). Savol: How often do you...?
examples: I go to the gym three times a week.
Men haftasiga uch marta sport zaliga boraman.
How often does he play chess?

dialog.title: Talking About Free Time
lines: What do you like doing in your free time?
Bo'sh vaqtingda nima qilishni yaxshi ko'rasan?
I like running and playing football. And you?
Men yugurish va futbol o'ynashni yaxshi ko'raman. Sen-chi?
I like swimming and going for walks in the park.
Menga suzish va parkda sayr qilish yoqadi.
Nice! Maybe we can go training together?

exercises: 5 ta sport turi nomini yozing.
«like + -ing» bilan 2 ta gap tuzing.
O'z hobbingiz haqida 3-4 gap yozing.
months.teacher: Talabalardan sinfda o'z sevimli sport turi haqida qisqa (30 soniyalik) og'zaki taqdimot qilishni so'rang.

dialog2.title: Hobbies and sport
lines: What do you do in your free time?
I like playing football with my friends.
Men do'stlarim bilan futbol o'ynashni yaxshi ko'raman.
Twice a week, on Tuesday and Saturday.
Haftasiga ikki marta, seshanba va shanba kuni.
I enjoy swimming, but I hate running.
Men suzishni yoqtiraman, lekin yugurishni yomon ko'raman.
Really? Running is good for health.
I know, but I prefer the pool.
Bilaman, lekin men basseynni afzal ko'raman.
Then let us go swimming together!

reading.title: My favourite sport
reading.text: My favourite sport is basketball. I play it with my classmates after school. We have a small team, and we play in the yard twice a week. Sport makes me strong and helps me make new friends. I want to join a real club next year.
reading.uz: Mening sevimli sportim basketbol. Men uni maktabdan keyin sinfdoshlarim bilan o'ynayman. Bizning kichik jamoamiz bor va haftasiga ikki marta hovlida o'ynaymiz. Sport meni kuchli qiladi va yangi do'stlar orttirishga yordam beradi. Kelasi yil haqiqiy klubga a'zo bo'lmoqchiman.
questions: What is the writer's favourite sport?
What does the writer want to do next year?

months.label: 7-oy

grammar.title: Sifatlarning qiyosiy darajasi
grammar.text: Qisqa sifatlarga -er qo'shiladi: cheap → cheaper (arzonroq). Uzun sifatlarda «more» ishlatiladi: expensive → more expensive. Istisno: good → better.
examples: Do you have a cheaper one?
These shoes are better than those.

more.title: Too va enough
more.text: too + sifat = ortiqcha (too small — juda kichik, yaramaydi). sifat + enough = yetarli (big enough — yetarlicha katta).

more.title: Kiyim fe'llari
more.text: wear — kiyib yurmoq, put on — kiymoq, try on — kiyib ko'rmoq, take off — yechmoq. Bularni adashtirmang.
examples: I put on my coat and went out.

dialog.title: At a Clothing Store
lines: Hello, can I try on this shirt?
Salom, shu ko'ylakni kiyib ko'rsam bo'ladimi?
Medium. How much does it cost?
It's fifty dollars, but there's a twenty percent discount today.
Ellik dollar, lekin bugun yigirma foiz chegirma bor.

exercises: 5 ta kiyim nomini yozing.
Qiyosiy daraja bilan 3 ta gap tuzing.
Do'konda kiyim tanlash dialogini yozing.
months.teacher: Sinf ichida "do'kon" o'yinini tashkil qiling: bir guruh sotuvchi, ikkinchisi xaridor bo'lib rol o'ynasin.

dialog2.title: Trying on clothes
lines: Yes, I am looking for a jacket.
Medium. Can I try this one on?
Of course. The fitting room is over there.
It is too small. Do you have a bigger one?
Yes, this one is larger and cheaper.

reading.title: Shopping online
reading.text: Today many people buy clothes online. It is easy and quick, and the prices are often lower. But there is a problem: you cannot try things on. My sister bought a dress that was too long, so she sent it back. Now she always checks the size chart carefully.
reading.uz: Bugun ko'p odamlar kiyimni internetdan sotib oladi. Bu oson va tez, narxlar ko'pincha past. Lekin muammo bor: kiyib ko'rib bo'lmaydi. Singlim juda uzun ko'ylak sotib oldi va uni qaytarib yubordi. Endi u doim o'lchamlar jadvalini sinchiklab tekshiradi.
questions: Why do people buy clothes online?
It is easy, quick and cheaper.
What was the problem with the dress?
What does the sister do now?
She checks the size chart carefully.

months.label: 1-oy

grammar.title: Sabab-natija qo'shma gaplari
grammar.text: Murakkab fikrni ifodalash uchun bog'lovchilardan foydalanib qo'shma gap tuzish kerak. 'Because' sababni, 'so' natijani bildiradi. 'If' shart, 'although' va 'despite' qarshilikni ifodalaydi.
examples: I didn't come because it was cold.
It was cold, so I didn't come.
Although it was cold, I came.

more.title: Bog'lovchilar: because, so, although
more.text: because — chunki (sabab), so — shuning uchun (natija), although — garchi (qarama-qarshilik), however — biroq (yangi gap boshida).
examples: I stayed at home because it was cold.
It was cold, so I stayed at home.
Sovuq edi, shuning uchun uyda qoldim.

more.title: Vergul qoidasi
more.text: so, but, however kabi bog'lovchilardan oldin (yoki keyin) vergul qo'yiladi. Because oldidan odatda vergul kerak emas.
examples: He was ill, but he went to work.
U kasal edi, lekin ishga bordi.

dialog.title: Nega kech qoldingiz?
lines: I was late because the bus came late.
Kech qoldim, chunki avtobus kech keldi.
I see. And why didn't you call?
Although I wanted to call, I had no money on my phone.
Qo'ng'iroq qilmoqchi bo'lsam-da, telefonimda pul yo'q edi.

exercises: 5 ta gapni 'because' yoki 'so' bilan bog'lang.
'Although' va 'despite' ishlatib 2 ta gap tuzing.
Nega ingliz tilini o'rganayotganingizni 3-4 gapda 'because' yordamida tushuntiring.
answers: Erkin javob — bog'lovchi to'g'ri joylashgani tekshiriladi.
months.teacher: Sinfda kichik debat tashkil qiling: talaba o'z fikrini albatta 'because' bilan asoslashi shart bo'lsin.

dialog2.title: Why were you late?
lines: So how did you get here?
I walked, so I am tired.
Although you are tired, you must finish the report.
Charchagan bo'lsangiz ham, hisobotni tugatishingiz kerak.
I will do it, but I need a coffee first.
Fine. However, please call me next time.
Mayli. Biroq keyingi safar menga qo'ng'iroq qiling.

reading.title: A bad morning
reading.text: Yesterday morning my alarm did not ring, so I woke up late. I ran to the bus stop, but the bus had already left. Although I took a taxi, I arrived ten minutes late. My boss was not angry because I explained everything honestly.
reading.uz: Kecha ertalab budilnikim jiringlamadi, shuning uchun kech uyg'ondim. Avtobus bekatiga yugurdim, lekin avtobus allaqachon ketgan edi. Taksi olgan bo'lsam ham, o'n daqiqa kech keldim. Boshlig'im jahli chiqmadi, chunki men hammasini rostgo'ylik bilan tushuntirdim.
questions: Why did the writer wake up late?
How did the writer get to work?
Why was the boss not angry?

months.label: 2-oy
tasks: Rasmiy va norasmiy nutq farqini o'rganish
Bitta soddalashtirilgan yangilikni tinglab tahlil qilish

grammar.title: Rasmiy va norasmiy uslub
grammar.text: Ingliz tilida notanish odamlarga yoki rasmiy vaziyatda 'Could you…', 'Would you mind…' kabi muloyim konstruksiyalar ishlatiladi. Do'stlar bilan 'Can you…' yoki buyruq gap yetarli. Rasmiy xat 'Dear + ism-sharif' bilan boshlanib, 'Sincerely' bilan tugaydi.

more.title: Rasmiy va norasmiy so'zlar
more.text: Norasmiy: get, buy, ask for, a lot of. Rasmiy: obtain, purchase, request, numerous. Rasmiy yozuvda qisqartmalar (don't, I'm) ishlatilmaydi.
examples: I would be grateful if you could help me.

more.title: Mashhur idiomalar
more.text: a piece of cake — juda oson; break the ice — muzni eritmoq; once in a blue moon — juda kamdan-kam. Idiomani so'zma-so'z tarjima qilmang.
examples: The exam was a piece of cake.
He visits us once in a blue moon.
U bizni juda kamdan-kam ziyorat qiladi.

dialog.title: Rasmiy va norasmiy taqqoslash
lines: Dear Director, I would like you to consider my application.
Hurmatli direktor, arizamni ko'rib chiqishingizni so'rayman.
Hey, can you help me with this, please!

exercises: 5 ta idiomani ma'nosi bilan moslashtiring.
Bitta gapni rasmiy uslubdan norasmiy uslubga o'zgartiring.
Qisqa rasmiy ariza namunasi yozing (3-4 gap).
answers: O'quvchi javobini o'qituvchi jadval bilan solishtiradi.
months.teacher: Rolli o'yin: bir guruh «ish suhbati» (rasmiy), boshqasi «do'stlar chati» (norasmiy) ssenariysini o'ynasin, keyin farqlarni birgalikda muhokama qiling.

dialog2.title: Writing a polite email
lines: I need to write an email to my manager.
No, that is too informal for a manager.
Yo'q, bu menejer uchun juda norasmiy.
How do I finish the email?
Do not forget to check your spelling.

reading.title: My first job application
reading.text: Last month I applied for my first job. I wrote a formal letter and attached my CV. I used polite phrases such as 'I am writing to apply' and 'I look forward to hearing from you'. A week later the company invited me for an interview.
reading.uz: O'tgan oy birinchi ishimga ariza berdim. Rasmiy xat yozib, rezyumemni biriktirdim. 'Murojaat qilish uchun yozyapman' va 'Javobingizni kutaman' kabi xushmuomala iboralardan foydalandim. Bir haftadan keyin kompaniya meni suhbatga taklif qildi.
questions: What did the writer attach to the letter?
What polite phrase did the writer use?
I look forward to hearing from you.
The company invited the writer for an interview.

months.label: 3-oy
tasks: Ish yoki madaniyat mavzusida erkin suhbat qurish

grammar.title: Fikr bildirish konstruksiyalari
grammar.text: Erkin suhbatda o'z fikringizni bildirish uchun bir nechta qolip iboralar mavjud. Bular nutqni tabiiyroq va ishonchliroq qiladi.
examples: In my opinion, this is an interesting tradition.
I believe that learning languages is important.
I feel that this is difficult.

more.title: Fikr bildirish
more.text: In my opinion... (fikrimcha), I think / I believe... (o'ylaymanki), As far as I am concerned... (menga kelsak). Rozilik: I agree, Exactly. Norozilik: I do not agree, I see it differently.
examples: I believe that reading is important.

more.title: Sabab va izoh so'rash
more.text: Why do you think so? — Nega unday deb o'ylaysiz? For example, / For instance, — masalan. Fikringizni misol bilan quvvatlang.
examples: For example, many people work from home.

dialog.title: Kasb va madaniyat haqida
lines: I'm a teacher. In my opinion, it's a very important profession.
Men o'qituvchiman. Menimcha, bu juda muhim kasb.
I agree. Which English traditions interest you?
Rozi man. Senga qaysi ingliz an'analari qiziq?
I think Christmas is a very beautiful holiday.

exercises: O'z kasbingiz haqida 4-5 gapdan iborat matn yozing.
Bitta bayram haqida fikringizni 'in my opinion' bilan yozing.
Kundalik (journal) yozishni boshlang — bugungi kun haqida 3 gap.
months.teacher: Har hafta uchun bitta yozish mavzusi belgilang va journal yozishni doimiy odatga aylantiring.

dialog2.title: Choosing a career
lines: What do you want to be in the future?
In my opinion, teaching is a noble job.
I agree, but the salary is low.
That is true, yet I prefer a job that helps people.
To'g'ri, lekin men odamlarga yordam beradigan ishni afzal ko'raman.
As for me, I would like to be an engineer.
Menga kelsak, men muhandis bo'lishni xohlayman.
I think it is creative and well paid.
Menimcha, bu ijodiy va yaxshi haq to'lanadigan kasb.
Both jobs are important for society.
Ikkala kasb ham jamiyat uchun muhim.

reading.title: Two cultures, one world
reading.text: My friend is from Japan and I am from Uzbekistan. Our cultures are different, but we have a lot in common. In both countries people respect their elders and love tea. When I visited her family, I learned to eat with chopsticks. She learned to bake bread in a tandoor.
reading.uz: Do'stim Yaponiyadan, men O'zbekistondanman. Madaniyatlarimiz har xil, lekin umumiy jihatlarimiz ko'p. Ikkala mamlakatda ham odamlar kattalarni hurmat qiladi va choyni yaxshi ko'radi. Uning oilasiga borganimda tayoqcha bilan ovqatlanishni o'rgandim. U tandirda non yopishni o'rgandi.
questions: Where is the writer's friend from?
To bake bread in a tandoor.

months.label: 4-oy
tasks: Bog'lovchi so'zlar (relative pronouns, because) bilan gapirish

grammar.title: Bog'lovchilar: which/that, because
grammar.text: Fikrni batafsil ifodalash uchun bog'lovchi so'zlar ishlatiladi: «which/that» (qaysiki) va «because» (chunki).
examples: This is the university which I graduated from.
I chose this major because it's interesting.
Men bu mutaxassislikni tanladim, chunki u qiziqarli.

more.title: Nisbiy olmoshlar: who, which, that
more.text: who — odamlar uchun, which — narsalar uchun, that — ikkalasi uchun. Ular gapga ma'lumot qo'shadi: The teacher who teaches us is kind.
examples: The book that I read was interesting.
The student who won is my friend.

more.title: Because va because of
more.text: because + gap (because it rained), because of + ot (because of the rain). Ikkalasi ham 'sababli' degani, lekin tuzilishi boshqa.
examples: We stayed home because of the storm.
We stayed home because there was a storm.

dialog.title: Talking About University Plans
lines: Where do you want to enrol?
I want to enrol at university, majoring in journalism.
Because I like writing and doing interviews.
Chunki menga yozish va intervyu olish yoqadi.

exercises: 5 ta ta'lim sohasiga oid so'zni yozing.
«which/that» va «because» bilan 2 tadan gap tuzing.
Kelajakdagi mutaxassisligingiz haqida qisqa matn yozing.
months.teacher: Talabalarga o'z kelajakdagi kasbi haqida 1 daqiqalik nutq tayyorlashni topshiring, «because» dan foydalanishlarini so'rang.

dialog2.title: Choosing a university
lines: Which university do you want to enter?
I want to enter the one that has a good IT faculty.
Yaxshi IT fakulteti bor universitetga kirmoqchiman.
Is it the university which is near the metro?
Yes, that is the one I mean.
Do you have to take an entrance exam?
Yes, because the competition is high.
I am sure you will pass.
I hope so. I am studying every day.

reading.title: Student life
reading.text: University life is very different from school. Students choose their own subjects and decide how to spend their time. There are many clubs, which help people to find friends. The most important thing is to study regularly, because exams are serious.
reading.uz: Universitet hayoti maktabdan juda farq qiladi. Talabalar o'z fanlarini tanlaydi va vaqtini o'zi taqsimlaydi. Ko'plab to'garaklar bor, ular do'st topishga yordam beradi. Eng muhimi — muntazam o'qish, chunki imtihonlar jiddiy.
questions: What do clubs help people to do?
What is the most important thing?

months.label: 5-oy

grammar.title: Sifatdosh oborotlari (Participle clauses)
grammar.text: Yozma va rasmiy nutqda ot va uni tavsiflovchi harakatni bitta gapga birlashtirish uchun -ing/-ed oborotlari ishlatiladi: pollution affecting the climate (iqlimga ta'sir qiluvchi ifloslanish).
examples: Pollution affecting the climate is increasing.

more.title: Participle iboralar: -ing
more.text: -ing sifatdosh asosiy gapga qisqa ma'lumot qo'shadi: The man standing there is my uncle (= who is standing). Walking home, I met a friend (= While I was walking...).
examples: The girl sitting by the window is my sister.
Deraza yonida o'tirgan qiz mening singlim.
Feeling tired, he went to bed.

more.title: -ed sifatdosh
more.text: -ed (yoki 3-shakl) sifatdosh majhul ma'no beradi: a broken window (sindirilgan oyna), the book written by Tolstoy (Tolstoy yozgan kitob).
examples: The trees planted last year are growing.

dialog.title: Discussing Ecology
lines: What do you think is most important for ecology?
Sizningcha, ekologiya uchun eng muhimi nima?
I think recycling is very important.
Menimcha, chiqindilarni qayta ishlash juda muhim.
I agree. We also need to protect forests.
Qo'shilaman. Yana o'rmonlarni himoya qilish kerak.
Yes, the climate is changing a lot because of pollution.
Ha, ifloslanish tufayli iqlim juda o'zgarmoqda.

exercises: 5 ta ekologiya so'zini yozing.
O'z fikringizni ekologiya haqida 3-4 gapda yozing.
Ifloslanishni kamaytirish uchun 3 ta taklif yozing.
months.teacher: Sinfda kichik debat tashkil qiling: bir guruh "texnologiya ekologiyaga foydali", ikkinchisi "zararli" tomonini himoya qilsin.

dialog2.title: Saving the environment
lines: Have you heard about the new recycling project?
Yangi qayta ishlash loyihasi haqida eshitdingizmi?
Yes. People living in our street collect plastic.
Walking to work also helps nature.
Ishga piyoda borish ham tabiatga yordam beradi.
True. Cars produce a lot of smoke.
Having planted fifty trees, our class won a prize.
Ellikta daraxt ekib, sinfimiz sovrin yutdi.
Congratulations! Trees give us clean air.
Tabriklayman! Daraxtlar bizga toza havo beradi.
We must protect nature for the next generation.
Kelajak avlod uchun tabiatni asrashimiz kerak.

reading.title: Our green planet
reading.text: Our planet is facing serious problems: pollution, climate change and the loss of forests. Governments must act, but each person can help too. Using less plastic, saving water and planting trees are simple steps. If everybody does a little, the result will be big.
reading.uz: Sayyoramiz jiddiy muammolarga duch kelmoqda: ifloslanish, iqlim o'zgarishi va o'rmonlarning kamayishi. Hukumatlar harakat qilishi kerak, lekin har bir inson ham yordam bera oladi. Kamroq plastik ishlatish, suvni tejash va daraxt ekish — oddiy qadamlar. Agar hamma ozgina qilsa, natija katta bo'ladi.
questions: What problems does the planet face?
Pollution, climate change, loss of forests.
Using less plastic / saving water / planting trees.

months.label: 6-oy
tasks: Ko'chirma va o'zlashtirma gapni (reported speech) farqlash

grammar.title: O'zlashtirma gap (Reported speech)
grammar.text: Boshqa birovning so'zini qayta aytib berishda o'zlashtirma gap ishlatiladi: «that» bog'lovchisi bilan. To'g'ridan-to'g'ri: «I will come». O'zlashtirma: He said that he would come.
examples: The journalist said that the news was true.
She thinks that advertisements aren't always reliable.
U reklama har doim ishonchli emas deb o'ylaydi.

more.title: Reported speech: zamon siljishi
more.text: Gapni boshqa odamga uzatganda zamon bir pog'ona orqaga suriladi: am/is → was, will → would, go → went. 'I am tired' → He said that he was tired.
examples: She said, 'I like music.' → She said that she liked music.
'I will come.' → He said he would come.

more.title: Savollarni uzatish
more.text: Ha/yo'q savollarda if/whether, so'z savollarda savol so'zi ishlatiladi, tartib darak gap kabi bo'ladi: He asked where I lived.
examples: She asked if I was ready.
They asked where we were going.

dialog.title: Discussing the News
lines: Yes, but not all sources are reliable.
Ha, lekin barcha manbalar ham ishonchli emas.
I agree, there's a lot of false information on social media.
That's why it's important to check several sources.
Shuning uchun bir nechta manbani tekshirish muhim.

exercises: 5 ta media sohasiga oid so'zni yozing.
O'zlashtirma gap bilan 3 ta gap tuzing.
Ishonchli manbani qanday aniqlash mumkinligi haqida fikringizni yozing.
months.teacher: Talabalarga bitta haqiqiy yangilikni tanlab, uni o'zlashtirma gap qolipida sinfga qayta aytib berishni topshiring.

dialog2.title: Did you read the news?
lines: Did you read the news this morning?
Yes. The article said that the economy was growing.
Ha. Maqolada iqtisodiyot o'syapti deyilgan edi.
The reporter told us that it would continue.
I asked my father if he trusted the news.
He said that he checked several sources.
U bir necha manbani tekshirishini aytdi.

reading.title: Media in our lives
reading.text: Every day we get news from television, newspapers and the internet. Social media is fast, but it is not always reliable. A good reader always asks: who wrote this and why? Teachers say that checking two or three sources is the best way to avoid fake news.
reading.uz: Har kuni yangiliklarni televizor, gazeta va internetdan olamiz. Ijtimoiy tarmoqlar tez, lekin har doim ishonchli emas. Yaxshi o'quvchi doim so'raydi: buni kim yozgan va nega? O'qituvchilar yolg'on xabardan qochishning eng yaxshi yo'li — ikki-uch manbani tekshirish, deydi.
questions: From TV, newspapers and the internet.
What is the best way to avoid fake news?

months.label: 7-oy

grammar.title: Qiyoslash ifodalari (like, as if)
grammar.text: Badiiy nutqda qiyoslash uchun «like» (kabi) va «as if» (go'yoki) ishlatiladi: This painting is like a window into another world (Bu rasm boshqa dunyoga oyna kabi).
examples: This painting is like a window into another world.
Bu rasm boshqa dunyoga oyna kabi.
Her voice sounded as if it were music.

more.title: like, as, as if
more.text: like + ot: She sings like a bird. as if / as though + gap: He talks as if he knew everything. the same as — bilan bir xil; different from — dan farqli.
examples: It looks as if it is going to rain.

more.title: San'at haqida gapirish
more.text: masterpiece (durdona), exhibition (ko'rgazma), portrait (portret), landscape (manzara), novel (roman), poet (shoir). Fikr: It reminds me of... (menga ... ni eslatadi).
examples: This poem reminds me of my childhood.

dialog.title: At an Art Exhibition
lines: Very much! This painting is like a window into another world.
Juda ham! Bu rasm boshqa dunyoga oyna kabi.
I don't know, but it gives real inspiration.
Bilmayman, lekin u haqiqiy ilhom beradi.

exercises: 5 ta san'at sohasiga oid so'zni yozing.
Qiyoslash ifodalari (like/as if) bilan 2 ta gap tuzing.
Sizga yoqqan san'at asari haqida qisqa matn yozing.
months.teacher: Talabalarni virtual san'at galereyasi (yoki mahalliy muzey) saytiga yo'naltirib, bitta asar haqida ingliz tilida sharh yozishni so'rang.

dialog2.title: At the museum
lines: This painting looks like a photograph.
It looks as if the artist used a camera!
I prefer abstract art, to be honest.
Rostini aytsam, men abstrakt san'atni afzal ko'raman.
Really? To me it seems like a mess of colours.
Rostdanmi? Menga u ranglar g'ovlashiga o'xshaydi.
Art is not the same as science; there is no single answer.
San'at fan bilan bir xil emas; yagona javob yo'q.
You are right. Who is your favourite writer?
Abdulla Qodiriy. His novels are unforgettable.
I agree. I read "O'tgan kunlar" twice.
Qo'shilaman. Men 'O'tgan kunlar'ni ikki marta o'qidim.

reading.title: The power of books
reading.text: A good book can change your life. It teaches you new things, shows other worlds and helps you understand people. My grandfather says that a house without books is like a body without a soul. Now I try to read at least twenty pages every day.
reading.uz: Yaxshi kitob hayotingizni o'zgartirishi mumkin. U sizga yangi narsalarni o'rgatadi, boshqa olamlarni ko'rsatadi va odamlarni tushunishga yordam beradi. Bobom kitobsiz uy ruhsiz tanaga o'xshaydi, deydi. Hozir men har kuni kamida yigirma bet o'qishga harakat qilaman.
questions: What can a good book do?
A house without books is like a body without a soul.
How many pages does the writer try to read daily?

months.label: 1-oy

grammar.title: Sinonimlardan uslubiy foydalanish
grammar.text: B2—C1 darajada maqsad — bir xil ma'noni turlicha ifodalay olish. Sinonimlar nutqning uslubiy rangini o'zgartiradi: ba'zilari neytral, ba'zilari kitobiy yoki hissiy bo'yoqqa ega.

more.title: Sinonimlar va ularning ottenkasi
more.text: Sinonimlar ma'nosi yaqin, lekin uslubi va kuchi har xil: big — large — enormous; say — state — declare. Rasmiy matnda kuchliroq, aniqroq so'zlar tanlanadi.
examples: The company faces a significant challenge.
She declared her intention to resign.
U iste'foga chiqish niyatini e'lon qildi.

more.title: Matn bilan ishlash
more.text: Matnni o'qiganda: 1) asosiy g'oyani toping (main idea), 2) dalillarni belgilang (supporting details), 3) noma'lum so'zni kontekstdan taxmin qiling.
examples: The main idea is that exercise improves memory.
Asosiy g'oya shuki, mashq xotirani yaxshilaydi.
This detail supports the author's claim.

dialog.title: Matn muhokamasi
lines: Did you read the article about climate?
Yes, it talks about huge changes in nature.
Ha, unda tabiatdagi ulkan o'zgarishlar haqida aytilgan.

exercises: 5 ta so'zga sinonim toping.
Berilgan qisqa matnni o'qib, asosiy g'oyani 2-3 gapda ayting.
Matndagi 3 ta so'zni sinonimga almashtirib qayta yozing.
months.teacher: Haftada bitta qisqa maqola tanlab, guruh bilan birga o'qing va tahlil qiling.

dialog2.title: Discussing a text
lines: What is the main idea of this text?
The author argues that technology changes how we think.
Muallif texnologiya fikrlash tarzimizni o'zgartiradi, deb ta'kidlaydi.
Yes, but "enormous" sounds a bit more formal.
I see. Style really depends on word choice.
Tushundim. Uslub so'z tanloviga bog'liq ekan.
Exactly. That is why a wide vocabulary matters.
Aynan. Shuning uchun boy lug'at muhim.

reading.title: Why vocabulary matters
reading.text: Researchers say that people with a rich vocabulary understand texts better and express their ideas more clearly. To expand your vocabulary, read widely, keep a notebook of new words and use them in your own sentences. Memorising lists alone is not enough; context is the key.
reading.uz: Tadqiqotchilarning aytishicha, boy lug'atga ega odamlar matnlarni yaxshiroq tushunadi va fikrini aniqroq ifodalaydi. Lug'atni boyitish uchun ko'p o'qing, yangi so'zlar daftarini yuriting va ularni o'z gaplaringizda ishlating. Faqat ro'yxatni yodlash yetarli emas; kontekst — asosiy kalit.
questions: Name one way to expand vocabulary.
Read widely / keep a notebook / use words in sentences.

months.label: 2-oy
tasks: Bahs yuritish va fikr bildirishni mashq qilish
Native speaker do'stlar bilan muntazam muloqot
vocab: on the one hand… on the other hand…
ɒn ði wʌn hænd… ɒn ði ʌðər hænd

grammar.title: Bahsli nutq tuzilishi
grammar.text: Yuqori darajadagi suhbatda fikrni tuzilgan holda bildirish muhim: avval pozitsiya, keyin dalil, so'ng qarama-qarshi fikrga munosabat. 'On the one hand… on the other hand…' konstruksiyasi ikki tomonlama fikrni ko'rsatishga yordam beradi.
examples: From my point of view, this problem is serious.
On the one hand it's useful, on the other hand it's risky.
Bir tomondan foydali, ikkinchi tomondan xavfli.
I would like to add that…

more.title: Bahs tuzilmasi
more.text: Kirish: Today I will talk about... Dalil: Firstly, ... Secondly, ... Qarshi fikr: On the other hand, ... Xulosa: In conclusion, ... Har bir dalil misol bilan quvvatlanadi.
examples: Firstly, it saves time. Secondly, it is cheap.
In conclusion, I strongly support this idea.
Xulosa qilib, bu g'oyani qat'iy qo'llab-quvvatlayman.

more.title: Rozilik va e'tiroz
more.text: To'liq rozilik: I totally agree. Qisman: I partly agree, but... E'tiroz: I am afraid I disagree because... Hurmat bilan e'tiroz qiling, shaxsga emas, fikrga qarshi chiqing.
examples: I see your point, but I disagree.
That is exactly what I think.

dialog.title: Debat mavzusida
lines: I believe online learning is more effective.
I disagree because face-to-face communication is more important.
Rozi emasman, chunki jonli muloqot muhimroq.
On the one hand you're right, but on the other hand technology gives flexibility.
Bir tomondan sen haqsan, lekin ikkinchi tomondan texnologiyalar moslashuvchanlik beradi.

exercises: Berilgan mavzuda ikki xil pozitsiyada gap tuzing.
Subtitrisiz qisqa video/film parchasini ko'rib, mazmunini aytib bering.
'From my point of view' bilan boshlangan 3 ta gap yozing.
answers: Erkin javob — o'qituvchi tushunish darajasini baholaydi.
months.teacher: Sinfni ikkiga bo'lib rasmiy debat tashkil qiling: har guruh bir tomonni himoya qilsin, so'ngra rollarni almashtiring.

dialog2.title: A school debate
lines: Today's topic: should students wear school uniforms?
Bugungi mavzu: o'quvchilar maktab formasini kiyishi kerakmi?
I am in favour. Uniforms make everyone equal.
On the other hand, they limit self-expression.
Boshqa tomondan, ular o'zini ifodalashni cheklaydi.
That is a fair point; however, they save time and money.
Bu o'rinli fikr; biroq ular vaqt va pulni tejaydi.
I would argue that students should have a choice.
Men o'quvchilarda tanlov bo'lishi kerak, deb bahslashaman.
I partly agree, but a choice can create competition.
Qisman qo'shilaman, lekin tanlov raqobat keltirib chiqarishi mumkin.
In conclusion, both sides have strong arguments.
Xulosa qilib aytganda, ikkala tomonning ham kuchli dalillari bor.

reading.title: Should homework be banned?
reading.text: Some countries are thinking about banning homework. Supporters say that children need time to rest and play. Opponents argue that homework teaches discipline and helps students remember lessons. Perhaps a balanced approach is best: short, meaningful tasks instead of long, boring ones.
reading.uz: Ba'zi mamlakatlar uy vazifasini taqiqlashni o'ylamoqda. Tarafdorlar bolalarga dam olish va o'yin uchun vaqt kerak, deydi. Qarshilar uy vazifasi intizomni o'rgatadi va darsni eslab qolishga yordam beradi, deb ta'kidlaydi. Ehtimol, muvozanatli yondashuv eng yaxshisi: uzun, zerikarli vazifalar o'rniga qisqa, mazmunli topshiriqlar.
questions: What do supporters of the ban say?
Children need time to rest and play.
A balanced approach with short, meaningful tasks.

months.label: 3-oy
tasks: Keyingi bosqich uchun yangi maqsad qo'yish

grammar.title: Rasmiy taqdimot va intervyu nutqi
grammar.text: Yakuniy bosqichda barcha o'rganilgan grammatik qoliplar birlashtiriladi: o'tgan tajriba haqida gapirish (Past Simple), kelajak rejalari (Future), fikr bildirish va dalillash konstruksiyalari. Rasmiy intervyuda aniq, tuzilgan javoblar talab qilinadi.
examples: I have experience working in this field.
My goal is to speak fluently in a year.
Mening maqsadim — bir yildan so'ng erkin gapirish.
I'm proud that I reached B2 level.

more.title: Taqdimot tuzilishi
more.text: Yaxshi taqdimot: 1) Greeting va mavzu, 2) Asosiy 2–3 nuqta, 3) Xulosa, 4) Savollar uchun taklif. Iboralar: Let me start by..., Moving on to..., To sum up..., Any questions?
examples: Let me start by introducing our project.
To sum up, we achieved all our goals.

more.title: Intervyu savollariga javob
more.text: STAR usuli: Situation (vaziyat), Task (vazifa), Action (harakat), Result (natija). Javoblaringiz aniq va misolli bo'lsin.
examples: I led a team of five and we finished two weeks early.
Men besh kishilik jamoani boshqardim va ikki hafta erta tugatdik.
My greatest strength is attention to detail.

dialog.title: Yakuniy intervyu
lines: Tell me about your experience learning English.
Ingliz tilini o'rganish tajribangiz haqida gapirib bering.
I studied English for a year. At first it was hard, but now I speak fluently and understand films without subtitles.
Men ingliz tilini bir yil o'rgandim. Boshida qiyin edi, lekin hozir erkin gapiraman va subtitrsiz filmlarni tushunaman.
What is your goal for the future?
My goal is to pass the C1 level exam.
Mening maqsadim — C1 darajasi imtihonini topshirish.

exercises: 1 daqiqalik o'zini tanishtirish nutqini tayyorlang va yozib oling.
Shu kungacha erishgan 3 ta yutuqni yozing.
Keyingi 6 oy uchun aniq maqsad qo'ying.
months.teacher: Bu darsda har bir talaba 1 daqiqalik taqdimot qilsin, guruh baholasin.

dialog2.title: A job interview
lines: Tell me a little about yourself.
I graduated last year and I have two years of experience.
Men o'tgan yili bitirdim va ikki yillik tajribam bor.
I am organised, responsible and a fast learner.
Men tartibli, mas'uliyatli va tez o'rganuvchiman.
Why do you want to work for us?
Because your company values growth and teamwork.
Chunki kompaniyangiz o'sish va jamoaviy ishni qadrlaydi.
Do you have any questions for us?
Yes. What does a typical day look like in this role?
Ha. Bu lavozimda odatiy kun qanday o'tadi?

reading.title: Preparing for an interview
reading.text: Before an interview, learn about the company and practise common questions. Dress neatly and arrive ten minutes early. During the conversation, make eye contact, listen carefully and give clear examples. After the interview, send a short thank-you message.
reading.uz: Intervyudan oldin kompaniya haqida bilib oling va odatiy savollarni mashq qiling. Chiroyli kiyining va o'n daqiqa oldin keling. Suhbat davomida ko'zga qarang, diqqat bilan tinglang va aniq misollar keltiring. Intervyudan so'ng qisqa minnatdorchilik xabarini yuboring.
questions: What should you do during the conversation?
Make eye contact, listen, give examples.

months.label: 4-oy
tasks: Dorixonada dori so'rash suhbatini mashq qilish
Shifokor bilan telefon orqali navbat olish dialogini yozish

grammar.title: Present Perfect bilan alomatlarni tasvirlash
grammar.text: Qancha vaqtdan beri o'zingizni yomon his qilayotganingizni yoki bir alomatga ega ekanligingizni aytish uchun Present Perfect + for/since ishlatiladi: «I have had a headache for two days». Bu shunchaki «I have a headache» dan farq qiladi (faqat hozirgi holat).
examples: I have had a fever since yesterday.
She has felt sick for three days.
U uch kundan beri o'zini yomon his qilyapti.
We have had a cold since Monday.

more.title: Present Perfect: have/has + V3
more.text: Natijasi hozirga ta'sir qiladigan ish: I have lost my keys (hozir yo'q). for + davom, since + boshlanish payti: for two days, since Monday.
examples: She has lived here for five years.
U bu yerda besh yildan beri yashaydi.
I have not eaten since morning.
Men ertalabdan beri hech narsa yemadim.

more.title: Ever, never, already, yet
more.text: ever (hech) — savolda, never (hech qachon), already (allaqachon) — darakda, yet (hali) — inkor va savolda gap oxirida.
examples: Have you ever been to a hospital?

dialog.title: At the doctor's
lines: Hello, doctor. I have a headache and a sore throat.
Salom, doktor. Boshim og'riyapti va tomog'im ham.
How long have you felt this way?
For two days. I think it's a cold.
Ikki kundan beri. O'ylaymanki, bu shamollash.
I'll write you a prescription. Drink more water and rest.
Sizga retsept yozib beraman. Ko'proq suv iching va dam oling.
Call an ambulance if it gets worse.

exercises: 5 ta alomat nomini yozing va ularni gapda ishlating.
Present Perfect + for/since bilan 3 ta gap tuzing.
Dorixonada retsept bo'yicha dori so'rash dialogini yozing.
months.teacher: Rolli o'yin: bir talaba bemor, ikkinchisi shifokor bo'lib real vaziyatni o'ynasin.

dialog2.title: Calling the clinic
lines: Hello, I would like to see a doctor.
I have had a headache since yesterday.
Yes, I have taken two tablets, but it has not helped.
Ha, ikki dona tabletka ichdim, lekin yordam bermadi.
The doctor is free at four o'clock.

reading.title: Stay healthy
reading.text: Doctors say that a healthy life is simple. Sleep at least seven hours, eat vegetables and fruit, drink enough water and walk every day. Do not forget to visit the doctor once a year, even if you feel fine. Prevention is better than cure.
reading.uz: Shifokorlar sog'lom hayot oddiy, deydi. Kamida yetti soat uxlang, sabzavot va meva iste'mol qiling, yetarli suv iching va har kuni sayr qiling. O'zingizni yaxshi his qilsangiz ham, yilda bir marta shifokorga ko'rinishni unutmang. Oldini olish davolashdan yaxshi.
questions: How many hours should we sleep?
How often should we visit the doctor?

months.label: 5-oy
tasks: Chipta bron qilish suhbatini mashq qilish
O'z sayohat marshrutingizni ingliz tilida tasvirlash

grammar.title: Sayohat rejalari uchun kelasi zamon (going to / will)
grammar.text: Sayohat rejalari haqida gapirishda odatda oldindan rejalashtirilgan harakatlar uchun «going to», tezkor qaror yoki bashorat uchun «will» ishlatiladi.
examples: I'm going to fly to London next month.
The flight will leave at seven.
We are going to book the tickets today.

more.title: Going to va Will — sayohat rejalari
more.text: Aniq reja: We are going to fly to Istanbul on Friday. Spontan qaror: The flight is delayed — I will wait in the cafe. Present Continuous ham yaqin rejalarda ishlatiladi: I am flying tomorrow.
examples: We are going to visit Paris next month.

more.title: Aeroport lug'ati
more.text: boarding pass (chiqish talonu), departure (jo'nash), arrival (yetib kelish), delay (kechikish), customs (bojxona), baggage claim (yukni olish).
examples: The flight is delayed by one hour.

dialog.title: At the airport
lines: Hello, I'd like to check in for my flight.
Here you are. I have luggage to check in.
Alright. Your flight has a connection in Istanbul.
Yaxshi. Sizning reysingiz Istanbulda almashinuv bilan.
Boarding starts in an hour, gate number five.

exercises: 5 ta transport bilan bog'liq so'zni gapda ishlating.
«going to» va «will» bilan 3 ta gap tuzing.
Chipta bron qilish uchun qisqa dialog yozing.
months.teacher: Haqiqiy chipta bron qilish saytining skrinshotidan foydalanib, talabalarga amaliy topshiriq bering.

dialog2.title: Checking in at the airport
lines: Good morning. May I see your passport and ticket?
Xayrli tong. Pasport va chiptangizni ko'rsam bo'ladimi?
Do you have any luggage to check in?
Would you like a window or an aisle seat?
Deraza yonini yoki yo'lak tomonni xohlaysizmi?
Your gate is number twelve. Boarding starts at ten.
Chiqish eshigingiz o'n ikkinchi. Chiqish o'ndan boshlanadi.
Thank you. Have a nice day.

reading.title: My first flight

grammar.title: Grammatika — qo'shimcha qo'llanma
grammar.text:
**To be (bo'lmoq) fe'li.** **Inkor:** I am **not** tired. **Savol:** Are you ready? **Egalik olmoshlari (my, your, his, her...).**
my, your, his, her, its, our, their — "kimning?" degan savolga javob beradi.
*Misol:* This is **my** book. Where is **your** pen? **Ko'plik son (Plural nouns).**
Odatda so'zga **-s** qo'shiladi: book → book**s**, cat → cat**s**.
Maxsus holatlar: child → child**ren**, man → m**e**n, woman → wom**e**n. **Artikllar (a / an / the).**
- **a** — undosh tovushdan oldin: a book, a car
- **an** — unli tovushdan oldin: an apple, an hour
- **the** — aniq, oldin aytilgan narsa haqida: The book on the table is mine. **Present Simple (Hozirgi oddiy zamon).**
Kundalik odat va faktlar uchun ishlatiladi.
*Misol:* I **live** in Tashkent. She **works** at school. *(3-shaxsda -s qo'shiladi: work → works)*
examples: You are my friend. (Sen mening do'stimsan.)

more.title: A1 grammatika xulosasi
more.text: A1 darajada asosiy tuzilmalar: to be (am/is/are), Present Simple, there is/are, can, have got. Gap tartibi: Ega + fe'l + to'ldiruvchi + joy + vaqt.
examples: I can swim, but I cannot dance.
Men suza olaman, lekin raqsga tusha olmayman.

more.title: Savol so'zlari

grammar.title: Grammatika — qo'shimcha qo'llanma
grammar.text:
**Present Continuous (Hozirgi davom etayotgan zamon).**
Hozir sodir bo'layotgan harakat uchun: am/is/are + fe'l-ing.
*Misol:* I **am reading** a book now. They **are playing** football. **Past Simple (O'tgan oddiy zamon).**
Tugallangan o'tgan harakat uchun. Muntazam fe'llarga **-ed** qo'shiladi.
*Misol:* I **worked** yesterday. She **visited** her grandmother.
Noto'g'ri fe'llar maxsus shaklga ega: go → **went**, see → **saw**, have → **had**. **Comparatives (Qiyoslash darajasi).**
- Qisqa so'zlar: **-er + than** → bigger than, faster than
- Uzun so'zlar: **more + than** → more beautiful than
- Istisno: good → better, bad → worse **Prepositions of time and place (Vaqt va o'rin predloglari).**
**at** (aniq vaqt: at 5 o'clock), **on** (kun: on Monday), **in** (oy/yil/shahar: in July, in Tashkent)
**in** (ichida), **on** (ustida), **under** (ostida), **next to** (yonida) **There is / There are.**
Biror narsa mavjudligini aytish uchun: **There is** a park near my house. **There are** many shops here.

more.title: A2: zamonlar umumlashmasi
more.text: Present Simple — odat; Present Continuous — hozir; Past Simple — tugagan ish; going to/will — kelajak. Zamon belgilari: every day, now, yesterday, tomorrow.
examples: I usually walk, but today I am taking a taxi.
Men odatda piyoda yuraman, lekin bugun taksi olyapman.

more.title: Modal fe'llar
more.text: can (qila olmoq), must (majbur), should (maslahat), may (ruxsat). Modal fe'ldan keyin to siz asl fe'l keladi.

grammar.title: Grammatika — qo'shimcha qo'llanma
grammar.text:
**Present Perfect (Hozirgi tugallangan zamon).**
Natijasi hozirgi vaqtga bog'liq bo'lgan o'tmish harakat: have/has + III-forma (past participle).
*Misol:* I **have finished** my homework. She **has never been** to London.
**Already, just, yet, ever, never** so'zlari ko'p ishlatiladi: *Have you **ever** visited Paris?* **Future forms (Kelasi zamon shakllari).**
- **will** — spontan qaror, taxmin: I think it **will** rain.
- **be going to** — reja, niyat: I **am going to** study medicine.
- Present Continuous — aniq kelasi reja: I **am meeting** him tomorrow. **Modal verbs (Modal fe'llar).** **First Conditional (1-turdagi shart gap).**
Real, mumkin bo'lgan kelasi shart: If + Present Simple, ... will + fe'l.
*Misol:* If it **rains**, I **will stay** home.

more.title: Conditionals 0, 1, 2
more.text: 0: If you heat ice, it melts (fakt). 1: If it rains, I will stay (real kelajak). 2: If I had time, I would travel (xayoliy hozir/kelajak) — if + Past Simple, would + fe'l.
examples: If I were you, I would accept the offer.
Sizning o'rningizda bo'lsam, taklifni qabul qilardim.
If we hurry, we will catch the train.

more.title: Present Perfect va Past Simple
more.text: Aniq o'tgan payt bo'lsa — Past Simple (yesterday, in 2020); payt noma'lum yoki hozirgacha davom etsa — Present Perfect (already, ever, for, since).
examples: Men 2015 yildan beri shu yerda yashayman.

reading.title: Work-life balance
reading.text: Many employees now ask for flexible schedules. Companies that agree often see higher productivity, because happy people work better. However, flexibility needs trust and clear rules. If both sides are honest, everybody benefits.
reading.uz: Ko'p xodimlar endi moslashuvchan jadval so'ramoqda. Rozi bo'lgan kompaniyalar ko'pincha yuqori samaradorlikka erishadi, chunki baxtli odamlar yaxshiroq ishlaydi. Biroq moslashuvchanlik ishonch va aniq qoidalarni talab qiladi. Agar ikki tomon halol bo'lsa, hamma foyda ko'radi.

tasks: Dialogni o'qib, ovoz chiqarib mashq qilish

grammar.title: Grammatika — qo'shimcha qo'llanma
grammar.text:
**Passive Voice (Majhul nisbat).**
Harakat qiluvchi emas, harakat qilinuvchi obyekt muhim bo'lganda ishlatiladi: be + III-forma.
*Misol:* The bridge **was built** in 1990. English **is spoken** all over the world. **Reported Speech (Ko'chirma gap).**
To'g'ridan-to'g'ri nutqni bошqa shaxs nomidan qayta aytish; zamon bir bosqich orqaga suriladi.
*Misol:* "I am tired," she said. → She said (that) she **was** tired.
"I will call you," he said. → He said he **would** call me. **Second & Third Conditional (2- va 3-turdagi shart gaplar).**
- **2-tur** (hozirgi/kelasidagi noreal): If + Past Simple, ... would + fe'l. *If I **had** more money, I **would travel** the world.*
- **3-tur** (o'tmishdagi noreal, afsus): If + Past Perfect, ... would have + III-forma. *If I **had studied** harder, I **would have passed** the exam.* **Relative Clauses (Bog'lovchi gaplar).**
who (odam uchun), which (narsa uchun), that (ikkalasi uchun), whose (egalik).
*Misol:* The man **who** helped me was very kind. This is the book **which** I told you about. **Gerund vs Infinitive.**
Ba'zi fe'llardan keyin **-ing** (gerund), ba'zilaridan keyin **to + fe'l** (infinitive) keladi.
*Misol:* I enjoy **reading**. (enjoy + -ing) — I want **to read**. (want + to)

more.title: Inversion va murakkab shartlar
more.text: Rasmiy uslubda if tushirilib, ega va yordamchi fe'l o'rni almashadi: Had I known, I would have called (= If I had known). Should you need help, call us. Were I you, I would wait.
examples: Had she studied harder, she would have passed.
Should you have any questions, please ask.

more.title: Akademik bog'lovchilar
more.text: nevertheless / nonetheless (shunga qaramay), furthermore / moreover (bundan tashqari), consequently (natijada), provided that (agar sharti bilan), whereas (holbuki).
examples: The plan is risky; nevertheless, we will try.
Reja xavfli; shunga qaramay, urinib ko'ramiz.
He is calm, whereas his brother is nervous.

dialog.title: Bahsli mavzu muhokamasi

Well, I think it has significant advantages, but it also raises some concerns.
Menimcha, bunda sezilarli afzalliklar bor, lekin ba'zi tashvishlarni ham keltirib chiqaradi.
For instance, it can be difficult to maintain a work-life balance if you're always at home. On the other hand, it gives people more flexibility.
Masalan, doim uyda bo'lsangiz, ish va shaxsiy hayot muvozanatini saqlash qiyin bo'lishi mumkin. Boshqa tomondan, bu odamlarga ko'proq moslashuvchanlik beradi.
That's a fair point. I suppose the outcome depends on how well a company manages it.
Bu adolatli fikr. Menimcha, natija kompaniya buni qanchalik yaxshi boshqarishiga bog'liq.
Exactly. If it's implemented thoughtfully, it could actually improve productivity.
Aynan. Agar bu puxta o'ylab amalga oshirilsa, bu aslida samaradorlikni oshirishi mumkin.

2. If I ___ (study) harder, I ___ (pass) the exam. (3-tur)

2. This is the book ___ I told you about.

dialog2.title: A debate on remote work
lines: Remote work has transformed the modern workplace.

reading.text: We live in an age of information overload. Every minute thousands of articles and videos appear online, and it is hard to tell truth from rumour. Critical thinking has therefore become one of the most valuable skills. Those who learn to question sources, compare evidence and stay open-minded will navigate the modern world with confidence.
